pillar: Problem/Frustration — coaches guessing, spreadsheet chaos, WhatsApp overload
caption:
You are managing fighters on spreadsheets and WhatsApp. 
That is not a system. 
You have athletes with different needs, different goals, different recovery times. 
One size fits all does not apply. 
Your fighters are entering camp, cutting weight, and sessions are piling up. 
Other coaches are still guessing. 
Some will wreck an athlete two weeks before the fight because they did not see the signs. 
You cannot afford to guess.
